title: Juicy Smoked Roman Black Bean Tacos
description: A vibrant and earthy Italian-inspired dish featuring char-grilled black beans, perfect for a quick and energizing lunch or dinner.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Drain and rinse the soaked black beans, then add them to a bowl with 1/4 cup of water.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl with the black beans and mix well.
Add the smoked paprika, ground cumin, and salt to the bowl and mix again.
Heat 1 tablespoon of roman-style extra virgin olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Remove the black bean mixture from the bowl and add it to the skillet. Cook for 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, warm the corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
To assemble the tacos, place a spoonful of the black bean mixture onto a warmed tortilla, followed by a sprinkle of chopped cilantro.
For an extra crunchy texture, top with chopped radishes or crispy tortilla strips.
